system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Managed Instance Group with autoscaling (min 1, max 5) behind an HTTPS Load Balancer.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Managed Instance Group with autoscaling (min 1, max 5) behind an HTTPS Load Balancer.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: instance-template
    type: compute.v1.instanceTemplate
    properties:
      properties:
        machineType: n1-standard-1
        disks:
        - deviceName: boot
          type: PERSISTENT
          boot: true
          autoDelete: true
          initializeParams:
            diskSizeGb: 30
            sourceImage: projects/debian-cloud/global/images/debian-11-bullseye-v20230214
        networkInterfaces:
        - accessConfigs:
          - name: External NAT
            type: ONE_TO_ONE_NAT
          network: $(ref.network.selfLink)
        metadata:
          startup-script: |
            #! /bin/bash
            apt update
            apt install -y apache2
            systemctl start apache2
            systemctl enable apache2
  - name: instance-group-manager
    type: compute.v1.instanceGroupManager
    properties:
      zone: us-central1-a
      instanceTemplate: $(ref.instance-template.selfLink)
      targetSize: 1
      autoHealingPolicies:
      - initialDelaySec: 300
      updatePolicy:
        type: PROACTIVE
        minimalAction: RESTART
        maxSurge: 1
        maxUnavailable: 0
  - name: autoscaler
    type: compute.v1.autoscaler
    properties:
      zone: us-central1-a
      target: $(ref.instance-group-manager.selfLink)
      autoscalingPolicy:
        minReplicas: 1
        maxReplicas: 5
        coolDownPeriodSec: 60
        cpuUtilization:
          utilizationTarget: 0.6
  - name: network
    type: compute.v1.network
    properties:
      autoCreateSubnetworks: true
  - name: backend-service
    type: compute.v1.backendService
    properties:
      backend:
      - group: $(ref.instance-group-manager.selfLink)
      healthChecks:
      - $(ref.health-check.selfLink)
      protocol: HTTPS
      portName: https
      timeoutSec: 30
      enableCDN: false
  - name: health-check
    type: compute.v1.healthCheck
    properties:
      checkIntervalSec: 5
      timeoutSec: 5
      unhealthyThreshold: 2
      healthyThreshold: 2
      httpHealthCheck:
        port: 80
        requestPath: /
  - name: url-map
    type: compute.v1.urlMap
    properties:
      defaultService: $(ref.backend-service.selfLink)
      hostRules:
      - service: $(ref.backend-service.selfLink)
        host: '*'
      pathMatchers:
      - name: path-matcher-1
        defaultService: $(ref.backend-service.selfLink)
        pathRules:
        - service: $(ref.backend-service.selfLink)
          paths:
          - '/*'
  - name: target-https-proxy
    type: compute.v1.targetHttpsProxy
    properties:
      urlMap: $(ref.url-map.selfLink)
      sslCertificates:
      - $(ref.ssl-certificate.selfLink)
  - name: ssl-certificate
    type: compute.v1.sslCertificate
    properties:
      privateKey: |
        -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

        7KxOqYOr8t+Q==
        -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
      certificate: |
        -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
        MIIDdTCCAl2gAwIBAgIVAMIIuj+uah1YFZpP8xN5ZUw1fMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEB
        CwUAMCQxIjAgBgNVBAMMGW5ncmF0c3RhY2sudGVzdDAeFw0yMzAyMjQwNTM5
        MzVaFw0zODAyMjQwNTM5MzVaMCQxIjAgBgNVBAMMGW5ncmF0c3RhY2sudGVz
        dDCCASIwDQYJKoZIhvcNAQEBBQADggEPADCCAQoCggEBALxTtC+qYj9hRj5
        0qYOr8t+Q==
        -----END CERTIFICATE-----
  - name: global-forwarding-rule
    type: compute.v1.forwardingRule
    properties:
      IPProtocol: TCP
      ports:
      - 443
      target: $(ref.target-https-proxy.selfLink)
      loadBalancingScheme: EXTERNAL
      subnetwork: $(ref.network.selfLink)
